Ava: hi team — just opened my first PR against main and CI is unhappy. I'm a bit lost on our branch naming, commit msg style, and what to include in the PR body. any quick checklist? :sweat_smile:

Riley: welcome! quick checklist:
- Branch name format: feat/ENG-<num>-short-desc or fix/ENG-<num>-short-desc. use kebab-case for the short-desc.
- Commit messages: we try to use conventional prefixes (feat:, fix:, chore:) followed by a short imperative summary. keep body optional but helpful.
- PR title: prefix with ticket [ENG-123] Short sentence.

Ava: thanks. the linter error points to src/lib/time.ts — how do I run the same checks locally?

DevBot: Installed hooks detected. To run linters & tests locally: ```bash
# install deps
pnpm install
# run formatter + linter
pnpm -w run format
pnpm -w run lint
# unit tests quick run
pnpm -w test -- --runInBand
```
If your editor integrates ESLint/Prettier, fix in-editor then re-run the pre-commit.

Riley: extra notes: our repo uses husky + lint-staged so unstaged files won't be auto-fixed. Stage them (`git add -p`) then commit. There's also a top-level script `scripts/check-pr.sh` that mirrors CI checks.

Ava: how strict are we about PR size and reviewers?

Jordan: default reviewer rules: 1 reviewer for docs/frontend-only, 2 for backend/core or infra. CODEOWNERS must approve if you touch owned paths. Aim for <300 LOC for quick review; >1000 LOC should be broken up. Also include a short "Testing" section in the PR describing manual steps and automated coverage touched.

Riley: when you fix CI, add a comment with `@DevBot please merge` if you want auto-merge when green. Otherwise maintainers may merge manually after approvals. Also add `CHANGELOG: skip` or `CHANGELOG: <one-line entry>` to help release notes.

Ava: got it. CI still failing on one flaky test in auth: `auth.spec.ts::should refresh token` — sometimes passes locally. What do we do?

Jordan: re-run the test job in CI once. If it flakes locally reliably, use `--runInBand` and `--testNamePattern 'should refresh token'` to debug. If you can't repro but CI flakes, add a comment in the PR and mark with label `flake-investigate` and we'll triage. Do not disable tests permanently.

DevBot: CI #4622 · redwood/ci · failed · mocha timeout in auth.spec.ts: https://ci.redwood/build/4622

Ava: ok I fixed a lint import order and adjusted the test to wait for token rotate. Pushed. Anything else I should check before asking for reviews?

Riley: run `git rebase origin/main` to pick up latest config, ensure no merge commits, squash WIP commits (`git rebase -i`) if the history is messy. PR description should include Motivation, What changed, How I tested, and any follow-ups.

Jordan: small tip: if you're changing public interfaces, add a note about compatibility and deprecation plan. For infra changes, ping #eng-infra for a quick policy check.

Ava: thanks all — will tidy up the branch and request reviews. appreciate the pointers! :pray:
